sources.access_detail: copy on file; access check: not located online or in the libraries checked
sources.note: Nothing about Alapmunte stress (phonology is Lakondê). Printed p. 39 fn. 26 quotes Telles 2002:11: Price (1972:99-100) took the Rondon & Faria group name 'Tauitê' as a corruption of dáwatté 'minha criança' 'em Alapmúnte', itself a corruption of 'Lakondê', so Rondon's Tauitê = Price's Alapmúnte; Tereza Lakondê instead affirms a distinct group called Alápmondê. Braga: 'como não há registros do grupo, que pode ter se extinguido prematuramente, não temos como afirmar a existência deste ou a sua relação com o Lakondê'.

sources.note: Nothing about Alapmunte stress (the phonology chapters describe Mamaindê only). Printed pp. 24-26 (PDF pp. 44-46): the oldest Mamaindê speak of the /jalapmũnʔ-tu/ ('grub-necked' or 'short-necked ones'; Alapmonde/Alapmunte/Yalapmunde), a group 'mentioned briefly in the literature but of which we know very little', placed by Price (1972:99-102) near the Roosevelt River; Price supposed Alapmunte was a variant name for the Lakondê (his Lakondê informant called his people Alakunde), Telles 2002:12 disagrees; 'Both of these groups and their languages are now extinct'; listed 'Of Unknown Intelligibi…

sources.note: Nothing; sec. 4(a) lists 'Alapmunte; Lakondê; Latundê; Mamaindé; Tawandê; Yalakalore' as the split and argues Northern Nambikuara is a cluster; no data on Alapmunte.

sources.citation: ISO 639-3 Registration Authority. 2007. Request for New Language Code Element in ISO 639-3: Alapmunte [apv] (primary requester David Eberhard, SIL; dated 2007-05-14; associated change request 2007-017, adopted 2008-01-14). 4 pp.
sources.note: Nothing; the primary record for the code leaves autonym and population blank, marks the language 'Recently extinct' with the last speaker 'before 1907', answers 'no literature' to what writings or recordings exist, and states 'There is insufficient information to determine the closest Nambiquaran language'. Sources listed are personal communication with the oldest Mamaindê speakers and Stella Telles, plus Lévi-Strauss 1948, Price 1972, Price 1978, Rondon & Faria 1947 and Mamaindê-only works.
